name: Rugged Thumbplate
description: Lunge on the lead foot and jab the plated fist at the nose with a breath of qi behind it.

name: Sturdy Fingerplate
description: Draw the cuffed elbow in against the ribs and let the plate take blows to the body.

name: Springing Knucklecap
description: Pull the lead foot back as the fist retracts so the distance stays the same.

name: Brisk Wristcuff
description: Turn the steel hand edgewise and chop it down across the side of the neck.

name: Fierce Grasp
description: Seat qi in the forearm and drive the steel fist down so the blow carries through a raised guard.

name: Dense Elbowcop
description: Ward a blow with the cuff and rebound the same arm into a counter strike in one turn.

name: Grim Vambrace
description: Drive the steel fingertips between the opponent's forearms to pry the guard apart.

name: Wring Flog
description: Rap the steel back of the hand across the wrist that holds a weapon.

name: Harsh Gauntcuff
description: Hammer the steel fist onto a raised forearm again and again until the arm goes numb.

name: Seizeup Screen
description: Press the cuffed forearm onto the opponent's lead arm and pin it low across the body.

name: Veering Backhandplate
description: Slide across the front of the opponent into the gap as the guard opens.

name: Brutal Cuffplate
description: Send a hard pulse of qi through the fist so the blow bursts a guard instead of bouncing off.

name: Brisk Palmguard
description: Hold the pinned arm under the cuff while the free steel fist drives into the exposed ribs.

name: Glovehasp
description: Meet a swing with the sharp-edged steel cuff held square to the blow.

name: Cruel Crushgrip
description: Whip the cuffed forearm backward into an attacker who closes from behind.

name: Glovescreen
description: Angle the cuff against a downward cut so the edge skids away to the side.

name: Lurching Crushgrip
description: Lift the cuff to clear a weapon and lunge in with the fist of the same arm.

name: Prowling Wristcuff
description: Square the shoulders behind both cuffs and walk forward under a rain of blows.

name: Pirouetting Clench
description: Roll the cuffed arms outward in a circle while backing out of range.

name: Resolute Vambrace
description: Harden the cuff with qi so a heavy axe blow rings off it and leaves the arm unhurt.

name: Mittscorer
description: Block with one cuff and strike with the other fist in a single turn of the shoulders.

name: Grasphasp
description: Reach the steel palm over a punch and grab the sleeve or wrist.

name: Honedmitt
description: Hook the steel fingers in the collar and drag the head down onto the rising fist.

name: Thumbplate Barrier
description: Twist the gloved wrist out through the thumb side of a grip that holds it.

name: Clay Wring
description: Turn on the rear foot with the seized arm in hand and bring the opponent round.

name: Viselike Fingerplate
description: Lock the steel fingers on a limb and feed qi into the clamp so it resists a hard pull.

name: Duskclench
description: Wrench the clamped limb against its joint to bring the opponent down to a knee.

name: Stern Knucklecap
description: Jab the mail-backed glove straight ahead from a close rank of comrades.

name: Gauntcuff Prop
description: Hold the mailed forearm up like a buckler across the chest and shoulder.

name: Clayvamb
description: Shove with the mailed forearm and shoulder to open a gap in a crowded press.

name: Ducking Clamp
description: Advance in time with the rank while keeping the mailed fist level and ready.

name: Levering Palmguard
description: Snatch a fallen sword or spear shaft with the steel fingers and fling it clear.

name: Brawnclamp
description: Sweep the mailed elbow around to clear attackers who crowd the side.

name: Vambslap
description: Press the mailed glove to the chest and drive qi through it in a short heavy thrust.

name: Cuffplate Prop
description: Spin the mailed forearm against a slash so the links catch the edge and turn it.

name: Guarding Elbowcop
description: Cover a neighbor's open side with the mailed forearm while qi hardens the arm against a lunge.

name: Honed Clamp
description: Drop the heavy fist on the count and recover to guard on the very next count.

name: Seizeup Flog
description: Strike low then high with the same fist in two even beats.

name: Shard Cuffplate
description: Hold the cuff still through a rest between beats then snap it up to stop a sudden blow.

name: Graspstalk
description: Slide off the line on the weak beat so the opponent's strike meets empty air.

name: Graspbuckle
description: Slap the backplate against the arm just as it starts to move and break the opponent's rhythm.

name: Brassglove
description: Time a qi pulse to the second beat of a pair so the second blow lands with double force.

name: Vambscreen
description: Rap the cuff on the attacker's forearm on his own beat and take over the timing of the exchange.

name: Wild Grasp
description: Lean the shoulder out and stretch the arm to land the plated fist at the very end of reach.

name: Hazeglove
description: Lay the whole steel forearm along a thrusting spear to carry its point away from the body.

name: Clay Clench
description: Raise the fist level with the shoulder and drop it like a hammer on the opponent's head.

name: Gauntcuff Zip
description: Lunge a full pace from the edge of reach to stand chest to chest with the opponent.

name: Rigid Fingerplate
description: Fold the arm tightly once the opponent is inside reach so the elbow plate takes the blows.

name: Draught Thumbplate
description: Send the rear arm across at full stretch to land a second blow from the opposite side.

name: Clenchhurdle
description: Slide out to full reach again after a close exchange and square up the shoulders.

name: Clayclamp
description: Push qi down the straightened arm so the thrust lands as though the reach were a hand longer.

name: Entangling Backhandplate
description: Sweep the cuffed arm in a wide flat arc to knock aside any weapon that enters its reach.

name: Sprig Vambrace
description: Pivot slowly around the extended guard arm and keep qi in it to hold the line.

name: Brawn Crushgrip
description: Slip the head outside a punch and answer with the steel fist to the exposed ribs.

name: Glovebarrier
description: Catch a punch on the steel cuff and brush it wide to open the opponent's side.

name: Grim Palmguard
description: Lean out of a swing then whip the steel back of the hand across the opponent's face.

name: Clenchcurl
description: Step back off a lunge and spring forward again the moment the attacker overreaches.

name: Draught Seizeup
description: Gather a breath of qi during a parry and release it in the answering blow.

name: Brawn Grasp
description: Turn aside a blow with the cuff and bring the same arm round into a hammering strike.
